description:
Goal

One source callable construction owns one runtime object and one producer-correlated member plan. Exact calls may use private ABIs; every indirect call consumes only the object's public ABI. Packaging contains closed physical contracts. No layer reconstructs evidence from keys, positions, Ty summaries, World scans, or sibling inventories.

Proven domain model

- Ty is callable supply: the authoritative abstract set of callable values. Closure literals carry target and capture Tys; intersection specializes them, union preserves alternatives, and callable_value_clauses is their legitimate eliminator. Do not add a parallel provenance lattice.
- CallableDemand is callable use: call surfaces and first-class/opaque escape required by consumers. Supply and use are independent monotone axes.
- Callable flow refines supply by actual use. Only this relation may produce callable target activations.
- ActivationKey is bounded identity. ActivationInputs is precise evidence. A key is never a source from which evidence may be recovered.
- Demand graph membership and callable-use ascent are mutually recursive and must settle as one fixpoint, whether represented in one product or a factored callable-use product. A fixed graph cannot be preclosed from supply.

Proven first losses

1. type_derived_flow_resolutions projects producer supply Ty into graph use before consumer use exists.
2. ground_surface_for_template_in_session searches global siblings and assigns a fitting ground surface to a producer that did not carry that use.
3. closure_callee_demand and CallableFlowBuilder drop exact target correlation where CallTargetSummary already owns it.
4. callable_flow_resolution_edges_product constructs precise inputs, mints a key, then retains only ExecutableKey.
5. SeedActivation reconstructs ActivationInputs from activation.inputs(); this is invalid once key collapse applies, even though existing precise contributions mask it in the Enum fixture.
6. Packaging historically repeated the same category error with symbolic positions and consumer-position identity.

Spike proof

- take_every: 3 surfaces -> 1 exact activation -> 1 physical shape row. No selection is necessary.
- drop_while: 3 surfaces -> 2 current activations. Type-derived seeding predicts only one; settled use later contains both.
- Removing Phase B loses five terminal reducer targets. Post-settle expansion finds those five but cannot replace Phase B because Phase B actually adds 27 upstream supply edges.
- The 27 Phase-B edges include source predicates and intermediate producers; the five actual-use edges are a different relation.
- Adversarial fixture: the same make lambda is constructed with integer and :unused captures. Only the integer construction is called; the atom construction is passed to ignore. Global sibling grounding plus Phase B demands and seeds both lambda activations. Therefore supply seeding provably over-demands unused code.
- Both ordinary and grounded-contract ignore(f) controls have zero callable input use. Unused supply must remain omitted.
- Ty already carries exact reducer capture alternatives. Separate provenance would duplicate facts and join semantics.
- Root Region::Type questions cannot observe nested distinctions that full Ty retains. Backend capability to synthesize structural questions is not authority to do so.

Construction strategy

1. Make exact direct target uses survive CallTargetSummary -> CallableDemand/flow without recomputation. Keep unresolved/public surfaces distinct.
2. Settle callable use and demand-graph membership as one monotone worklist. Start from direct calls and explicit closure-call uses; propagate use backward through existing lowered joins, call arguments, and captures; add a target only when use reaches callable supply.
3. Carry precise activation evidence with every newly refined latent target. Publish it as an ActivationInputs contribution; never rebuild it from the key.
4. Delete type_derived_flow_resolutions, its supply-derived Phase B and dependency machinery, and ground_surface_for_template_in_session.
5. Collapse same-target members before transport. If distinct keys have no preserved runtime observation, collapse identity upstream; never synthesize patterns from Ty.
6. Re-evaluate runtime_envelope and callable Region::Type after reconstructed dispatch is gone. Retain only forward runtime-observable abstraction.
7. Remove all spikes and obsolete exact-count tests. Fewer activations, members, shapes, captures, events, and allocations are improvements unless behavior or an owned boundary requires them.

Physical model retained

- CallableFlowFact owns function, captures, member resolutions, input mappings, direct/public uses, and consumer-owned result demand.
- TransportLayout is structural shape plus carrier; Nothing cannot carry ValueRef.
- BackendValueLayout closes shape, carrier, tys, and reprs. BackendReturnLayout adds divergence.
- Positions end at RootBackendProduct. Indirect edges carry sealed return flow like direct/dispatch edges.
- Public return is Diverges, Absent, or ValueRef from settled consumer demand across all members.
- Distinct source constructions remain distinct objects when joined. Construction identity is allocation-only.

Acceptance

- Unused callbacks remain unactivated and omitted, including a grounded sibling beside a used construction of the same lambda source.
- Every target is justified by actual callable use; no target/evidence is inferred from supply Ty alone, ActivationKey, TransportPosition, semantic return type, World/sibling scans, or first-member layouts.
- Runtime selection contains only distinctions backed by a preserved observation.
- Enum operator-ref/take/drop/split/search, Range, opaque ignored/consumed controls, recursive controls, resource controls, interpreter, JIT, and CLI behavior pass.
- Packaged/native types contain no TransportPosition or symbolic ABI inputs.
- Full library and strict clippy pass except only separately-owned raw telemetry handler baselines.
- Release fixture 00181 emits no diagnostics and telemetry remains near the proven 1,114-record envelope.

comments.text: Refinement-only model correction: downstream must never infer or reverse-engineer an observable discriminator from Ty. Preserve an authoritative observation witness forward, or collapse targets where they diverge. Real-fixture spikes found zero direct-callsite runtime-predicate collisions. Callable construction edges do collide, but exact {[], int} vs {[int], int} edges resolve to the same executable and must not motivate dispatch. Remaining split-family distinct targets have identical transported shapes; drop_while differs only in boolean lane identity while retaining the same tuple structure. Structural DispatchMatrix capability is therefore not proof of necessity. Current lead: DispatchDemand is forward-derived from EntryDispatch and convergence-collapse is the existing key abstraction, but CallableSurface/CallableFlowEdge retain only Ty surfaces. Prove whether ignored tuple-union correlation and scalar literals should collapse at key formation; do not synthesize patterns later.

Proven refinement boundary from the real Enum fixture:

- CallTargetSummary already owns the authoritative pair (surface_inputs, exact activation).
- closure_callee_demand discards target.activation and retains only surface_inputs. CallableDemand and CallableFlowBuilder then transport surfaces without their resolution.
- callable_flow_resolution_edges_product later calls world.activation_key over producer captures plus those surfaces, reconstructing the discarded target relation.
- take_every exposes 3 transported surfaces, all belonging to 1 exact activation and 1 physical shape row. They must collapse; there is no dispatch decision.
- drop_while exposes 3 transported surfaces belonging to 2 exact activations and 2 shape rows. The downstream closure CallTargetSummary facts contain both targets. Type-derived cone seeding reconstructs only the :true target and misses the mixed :false|:true target, while settled flow contains both. Reconstruction is therefore both unnecessary and incomplete.
- The owner activation has no local lambda CallTargetSummary because invocation occurs downstream. Exact target evidence must flow backward through callable demand/value joins to the producer; the producer must refine that preserved relation into its flow fact, never parse Ty or recompute activation.
- Direct exact resolutions and unresolved/public surfaces are distinct domains. Exact calls preserve CallTargetSummary edges. A first-class public surface may be combined with authoritative producer identity to resolve a target for the first time. Do not put both into one resolved surface set.
- Delete the synthetic pattern-from-Ty spike direction. Dispatch capability is not proof that a discriminator is necessary.

Next spike gates before implementation: prove direct CallSiteSummary closure over the whole demand cone already includes the target members currently added by type_derived_flow_resolutions; delete the type-derived phase disposably and observe membership/fixpoint behavior. Then TDD a split CallableDemand/CallableFlowBuilder model that carries exact direct resolutions and only resolves genuinely public surfaces at the producer.

title: fz-k22: preserve producer callable constructions behind one public indirect ABI
